rules.logic: ABIOC(RSC Deserialization RCE App Container CGO Spawns an Interactive Shell) AND ABIOC(Kubernetes Service Account Token Read by an Anomalous Descendant of the App Container CGO) AND ABIOC(In-Pod Kubernetes API Secret Enumeration from an App-Rooted Process Lineage) AND ABIOC(SSRF-Driven Instance Metadata Node IAM Role Theft from a Container Process) AND ABIOC(Stolen Node IAM Role Used in the Cloud Control Plane After Pod Compromise) within 600 seconds. The four endpoint ABIOCs share ONE join key — the pod causality chain (causality_id / causality_actor_process_instance_id, all rooted at the app-container CGO) — so the shell spawn, token read, K8s API enumeration, and IMDS theft fuse into one pod incident. The cloud ABIOC emits a node IAM role ARN (an AssumedRole), not the pod causality_id — the stolen credential is discarded on the endpoint and never carried in xdr_data — so it is bridged to the endpoint stages NOT on a shared process field but via the cloud asset-inventory mapping agent_hostname -> instance -> attached node IAM role (the shared entity), correlated on that host/instance-to-role bridge plus the tight window immediately following the endpoint IMDS reach. This fuses the RSC deserialization RCE, the service-account-token theft, the in-cluster secret enumeration, the node-role theft, and the cloud control-plane reuse into ONE React2Shell pod-RCE-to-cloud incident.
rules.name: React2Shell Pod-RCE to Cloud Control-Plane Pivot — ABIOC Causality Stitch
